rows.question: 为什么月亮白天也会出现?
rows.answer: 月亮其实是不会自己发光的哦！它看起来亮亮是因为它反射了太阳的光芒，就像你照镜子一样！所以，白天我们也能看到月亮哦。😊

rows.question: 为什么月亮白天也会出现?
rows.answer: 月亮其实一直都在那里呀，它没有像太阳一样自己发光哦！我们白天看月亮，是因为它被太阳照亮了，就像镜子一样反光给我们看一样。✨

rows.question: 为什么月亮白天也会出现?
rows.answer: 月亮其实一直都在那里哦，它不会像太阳一样“开灯”啦！我们白天看不到它，是因为太阳的光太亮了，把月亮的光盖住了。不过，有时候它会偷偷溜出来给你看呢！✨

rows.question: 蚂蚁为什么排队走路?
rows.answer: 蚂蚁排队走路，是因为它们有“小团体精神”！ 🐜 就像我们玩游戏一样，它们会成群成队地找食物，这样找起来才更厉害哦！

rows.question: 蚂蚁为什么排队走路?
rows.answer: 蚂蚁排队是因为它们是团队合作的小家伙！它们需要成群结队地搬运食物，这样才能把很多东西都带回它们的家哦！🐜🐜

rows.question: 蚂蚁为什么排队走路?
rows.answer: 蚂蚁排队走路，是因为它们很聪明，知道要一起找食物！就像小朋友排队上车一样，这样它们就能找到最多的食物啦！🐜🐜

rows.question: Why is the sky blue?
rows.answer: The sky is blue because of tiny bits in the air, like little bouncy balls! These bits like to scatter the blue light all over the place. That makes the sky look like a big blue blanket! 😊

rows.question: Why is the sky blue?
rows.answer: The sky is blue because of tiny things in the air! They act like little bouncy balls that scatter the blue light all around. That makes the whole sky look blue to us! 😊

rows.question: Why is the sky blue?
rows.answer: The sky is blue because of tiny things in the air, like little bouncy balls! These bouncy balls like to bump into the blue light from the sun more than other colors. So, the blue light scatters all around us, making the sky look blue! ✨

rows.question: How do fish breathe under water?
rows.answer: Fish have special parts in their mouths called gills! These gills help them breathe the oxygen that is floating in the water, just like we breathe air! 🐠💧

rows.question: How do fish breathe under water?
rows.answer: Fish have special things called gills! 🐟 They use their gills to grab the oxygen that is hiding in the water, just like we breathe air. So, they breathe underwater by sipping the air out of the water!

rows.question: How do fish breathe under water?
rows.answer: Fish have special things called gills! 🐠 They use their gills to take the oxygen that is hiding in the water, just like we breathe air! So, they are like underwater air-drinkers! 😊

rows.question: 为什么 dinosaurs 会 extinct?
rows.answer: Dinos went extinct because of a really big, space rock! ☄️ This rock hit Earth and made a huge mess. It changed the world so much that the dinosaurs couldn't live anymore. 😥

rows.question: 为什么 dinosaurs 会 extinct?
rows.answer: 🦕 恐龙们灭绝了，是因为一个超级大的小行星砸到了地球！💥 这个大石头让地球变得很热，食物和环境都变了，所以很多恐龙都搬家不去了。

rows.question: 为什么 dinosaurs 会 extinct?
rows.answer: 想象一下，恐龙们生活在一个很酷的世界里，但是后来，一个超级大、超级厉害的流星砸下来了！💥 这个大石头让世界变得很不一样，很多恐龙就没能活下来啦。😔
